'''Hun-Saare''' or '''Duka''' is a [[Kainji language]]<ref>{{Glottolog|huns1239|Hun-Saare}}</ref> of [[Nigeria]]. The eastern and western dialects are known as Hun (Ut-Hun) and Saare (Us-Saare), but speakers use ''Saare'' for both.
